verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV supports background automation via webhooks (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED) and a no-code Workflow Management editor that can run conditional verification checks without manual intervention, which enables some autonomous background processing. However, there is no evidence of AI-agent-specific automation setup, natural-language automation configuration, or scheduling/triggering by an AI agent itself. Missing for 10: explicit AI-agent-driven automation setup, natural-language workflow configuration, evidence of autonomous agent-triggered verification chains beyond webhook/workflow primitives.
